title: payload: task_outcome v2
description: AgentMeasure Task Outcome payload — v2 adds outcome_class, observer_grade, and stratified fields. v1 fields retained for backward compatibility. Draft 0.4.4.

task_success.description: v1 legacy: binary success indicator. v2 consumers SHOULD prefer outcome_class for richer semantics.

outcome_class.description: v2: outcome classification from registry vocabularies.yaml. When present, takes precedence over task_success for semantic analysis.

outcome_observer_grade.description: v2: who attests this outcome. Defaults to self_attested when omitted.

attempt_count.description: Optional declared attempt count; the aggregator reconciles it against attempt rows (#9), never trusts it.

capability_ids.description: v2: capabilities involved in producing this outcome. Enables stratified aggregation by capability (preventing 5-min resolution and 3-day reopens from pooling into the same outcome_count).

primary_operation_id.description: v2: the primary operation whose execution determined this outcome. For stratified lift analysis.

effect_confirmation_refs.description: v2: references to effect_confirmed payloads that support this outcome determination. Enables traceability for OUT-002.
